correctness.rationale: The displayed smoothness exclusions guarantee a genus-three curve and nonsingular degree-two elliptic quotients. Classical binary-quartic invariants yield exact formulas with denominators A,B,D nonzero. Cross multiplication factors as 4(a+b)H with H=-F, giving an exhaustive iff. The birational (a,b)<->(u,v) map reduces the residual to a primitive bidegree-(4,4) polynomial K. The rational parametrization u=z^4,v=((z+i)/(z-i))^4 has four distinct v-values above generic u, exhausting the degree-four polynomial and proving irreducibility and rationality; boundary components do not arise. The exact saved SymPy verifier recomputes these identities, the rational inverse, and a nonsymmetric smooth witness with j(E_tau)=j(E_sigma-tau)=1728 and j(E_sigma)=-8000/81. Infinite irreducibility is proved, not inferred from samples.

Shaska 2014 addresses isomorphism of a pair of degree-four elliptic subcovers and five corresponding genus-zero components; this does not imply equality of this explicitly marked pair of degree-two subcovers. Inspected primary sources and mathematical-record searches found no dominating result. This is self-review, not proof of universal priority.
